description:
The user approved step C, a per-process continuation region, relayed by Callables on 2026-11-19. This answers decision 72 (3). Design page: https://claude.ai/artifact/DLaBcsPBUr1LwXpc4rhAvX. Owner: Callables. Retargeted 2026-11-20 as S4 of fz-9x7.44 ("Scalars without addresses", user approved, https://claude.ai/artifact/6jYdi5cw1d27CZC85xkJih): blocked by fz-9x7.44.9, after which no ref names a number and region pops are unconditional.

## Design
- The region is made of aligned chunks, with a pointer-only room test.
- Pop is cont_top = frame.
- The handler record saves cont_top, and a raise resets to it.
- Region frames are collector roots.
- No pin test, no scalar area, no floor: addendum PEgbhjGkqm6iD2gSG5s4io D1 is void.
- D2 counters come after fz-9x7.37.3.

## Removes
release_resumed_frame's tests, the continuation kind bytes, frame_in_tip_or_copy, fz_frame_for_write and frame_copies.

comments.text: Make Distiller Fast's prediction (page 4JyVHKjbDBw1bzRDu17PZd v5 §9): 64.4M decode continuations × (170 − 22) ≈ 9.5G less parse work, so the gap to the BEAM goes from ~24.0G to ~14.5G. N4 is folded into this ticket.

From fz-9x7.42's results (Callables, develop 1d2b4f6fa), in scope here:
(a) The frame-copy path (frame_in_tip_or_copy/fz_frame_for_write) is deleted; a long body's frame is written in place (01254, 01256, distiller timeline/1).
(b) A long body ending in a tail call pops at its last call (01166).
(c) Receive: the runtime builds the outcome frame on the region in the parked frame's place (park.rs resume_closure). The raise handler (materialize_outcome_closure) is pushed after resetting to the saved cont_top.
(d) A mid-flight yield's frame points down the stack, so it is not a holder and builds on the region like any other frame.
(e) A process exiting with live frames needs nothing: the region goes with the process.
Debug checks replace the spike: assert each pop is at or below cont_top, and during a collection assert that no heap object points into a region chunk. The spike diff (9 files) is in Callables' scratch for the builder.

The fz-9x7.42 spike diff (9 files: runtime/src/cont_spike.rs plus hooks in closure.rs, entry.rs, park.rs, failure.rs, heap/imp.rs, process.rs, sched_core.rs, lib.rs) is at /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-9x7.42-spike.diff, off develop 1d2b4f6fa. It is reference material only and never lands.

title: A continuation lives in its process's continuation region and is given back by one store
